text.en: a. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production,” of commodities specified in 3B001.a.4, c, d, f.1, f.5, f.6, k to n, p.2, p.4, r, or 3B002.c.

text.zh: b. 为将多个裸片集成到“多芯片”集成电路中而设计，且具有以下全部功能的“电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）“软件”：
text.en: b. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') “software” designed for the integration of multiple dies into a 'multi-chip' integrated circuit, and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 布局规划；以及
text.en: b.1. Floor planning; and

text.zh: b.2. 裸片与封装的协同设计或协同仿真。
text.en: b.2. Co-design or co-simulation of die and package.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3D992.b而言，“多芯片”包括多裸片和多芯粒。
text.en: For the purposes of 3D992.b, 'multi-chip' includes multi-die and multi-chiplet.

text.zh: c. 未由3D992.a列明、为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与此类设备配合执行以下全部操作而设计或改装的“软件”：
text.en: c. “Software” not specified by 3D992.a designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

text.zh: c.1. 减小3B001.f.1.b所列最小可分辨特征；以及
text.en: c.1. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B001.f.1.b; and

text.zh: c.2. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大“专用卡盘套刻精度”降低至小于或等于1.5 nm。
text.en: c.2. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography equipment below or equal to 1.5 nm.

text.en: a. “Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of commodities specified in 3B993.

text.zh: b. 为运用多重图形化“开发”或“生产”集成电路而设计或改装的“电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）“软件”。
text.en: b. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') “software” designed or modified for the “development” or “production” of integrated circuits using multipatterning.

text.zh: c. 为“开发”或“生产”DUV光刻掩模或光刻版上的图案而设计或改装的“计算光刻”“软件”。
text.en: c. 'Computational lithography' “software” designed or modified for the “development” or “production” of patterns on DUV lithography masks or reticles.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3D993而言，“计算光刻”是指运用计算机建模，对一系列图案、工艺和系统条件下的光刻工艺成像性能进行预测、校正、优化和验证。
text.en: For the purposes of 3D993, 'computational lithography' is the use of computer modelling to predict, correct, optimize and verify imaging performance of the lithography process over a range of patterns, processes, and system conditions.

text.zh: d. 为使3B001.f.1或3B993.f.1所列设备每小时处理的晶圆数量（在任何时间间隔内取平均值）增加超过1%而设计或改装的“软件”。
text.en: d. “Software” designed or modified to increase the number of wafers processed per hour, averaged over any time interval, by greater than 1%, of equipment specified in 3B001.f.1 or 3B993.f.1.

text.zh: e. 未由3D993.a列明、为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与此类设备配合执行以下全部操作而设计或改装的“软件”：
text.en: e. “Software” not specified by 3D993.a designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

text.zh: e.1. 减小3B993.f.1.b.1所列最小可分辨特征；以及
text.en: e.1. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B993.f.1.b.1; and

text.zh: e.2. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大“专用卡盘套刻精度”降低至大于1.5 nm且小于或等于2.4 nm。
text.en: e.2. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography equipment above 1.5 nm and below or equal to 2.4 nm.

text.en: a. A 'vector processor unit' designed to perform more than two calculations on 'floating-point' vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 32-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3E002.a而言，“向量处理器单元”是具有内置指令、可同时对“浮点”向量（由32位或更大位数构成的一维数值数组）执行多次计算的处理器单元，具有至少一个向量算术逻辑单元以及每个包含至少32个元素的向量寄存器。
text.en: For the purposes of 3E002.a, a 'vector processor unit' is a processor element with built-in instructions that perform multiple calculations on 'floating-point' vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 32-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously, having at least one vector arithmetic logic unit and vector registers of at least 32 elements each.

text.zh: b. 设计为每个周期产生四个以上64位或更大位数的“浮点”运算结果；或
text.en: b. Designed to perform more than four 64-bit or larger 'floating-point' operation results per cycle; or

text.zh: c. 设计为每个周期产生八个以上16位“定点”乘加结果（例如，对先前已转换为数字形式的模拟信息进行数字处理，也称为数字“信号处理”）。
text.en: c. Designed to perform more than eight 16-bit 'fixed-point' multiply-accumulate results per cycle (e.g., digital manipulation of analog information that has been previously converted into digital form, also known as digital “signal processing”).

text.en: 3E002 includes “technology” for the “development” or “production” of digital signal processors and digital array processors.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3E002.a和3E002.b而言，“浮点”的定义见IEEE-754。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3E002.a and 3E002.b, 'floating-point' is defined by IEEE-754.

text.zh: 2. 就3E002.c而言，“定点”指同时包含整数部分和小数部分的固定位宽实数，不包括纯整数格式。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3E002.c, 'fixed-point' refers to a fixed-width real number with both an integer component and a fractional component, and which does not include integer-only formats.

text.zh: 相关管制：1. ECCN 3E905适用于在半导体晶圆生产设施中专门用于“开发”或“生产”集成电路GAAFET结构的工艺“技术”。例如，ECCN 3E905不管制集成电路设计（如“GDSII”格式的物理版图文件）、EDA工具，或用于生成集成电路设计物理版图文件的任何其他技术。2. ECCN 3E905不适用于垂直GAAFET架构，例如用于3D NAND的架构。
text.en: Related Controls: 1. ECCN 3E905 applies to process “technology” exclusively for the “development” or “production” of GAAFET structures of integrated circuits at a semiconductor wafer production facility. ECCN 3E905 does not, for example, control an integrated circuit design such as the physical layout file in “GDSII” format or EDA tools, or any other technology used to produce the physical layout file for integrated circuit design. 2. ECCN 3E905 does not apply to vertical GAAFET architectures, e.g., those used for 3D NAND.

text.en: —'Vector processors' (as defined in Note 7 of the “Technical Note on “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”)”);

text.en: —Equipment designed for “image enhancement.”
Note 2:

text.zh: 在满足下列条件时，4A003所述“数字计算机”及相关设备的管制状态由其他设备或系统的管制状态决定：
text.en: The control status of the “digital computers” and related equipment described in 4A003 is determined by the control status of other equipment or systems provided:

text.zh: a. “数字计算机”或相关设备为其他设备或系统运行所必不可少；
text.en: a. The “digital computers” or related equipment are essential for the operation of the other equipment or systems;

text.zh: b. “数字计算机”或相关设备不是其他设备或系统的“主要组成部分”；以及
text.en: b. The “digital computers” or related equipment are not a “principal element” of the other equipment or systems; and

text.zh: 特别提示1：
为其他设备“专门设计”、且功能限于该其他设备所需功能的“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备，即使超过“主要组成部分”标准，其管制状态仍由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
text.en: The control status of “signal processing” or “image enhancement” equipment “specially designed” for other equipment with functions limited to those required for the other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment even if it exceeds the “principal element” criterion.

text.zh: 特别提示2：
用于电信设备的“数字计算机”或相关设备的管制状态，见第5类第1部分（电信）。
text.en: For the control status of “digital computers” or related equipment for telecommunications equipment, see Category 5, Part 1 (Telecommunications).

text.zh: c. “数字计算机”及相关设备的“技术”由4E确定。
text.en: c. The “technology” for the “digital computers” and related equipment is determined by 4E.

text.en: b. “Digital computers” having an “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”) exceeding 70 Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT);

text.zh: c. 经“专门设计”或改装，可通过处理器聚合提升性能，使聚合后的“APP”超过4A003.b限值的“电子组件”；
text.en: c. “Electronic assemblies” “specially designed” or modified to be capable of enhancing performance by aggregation of processors so that the “APP” of the aggregation exceeds the limit in 4A003.b.;
Note 1:

text.zh: 4A003.c仅适用于在以未集成的“电子组件”形式装运时不超过4A003.b限值的“电子组件”和可编程互连装置。
text.en: 4A003.c applies only to “electronic assemblies” and programmable interconnections not exceeding the limit in 4A003.b when shipped as unintegrated “electronic assemblies.”
Note 2:

text.zh: 4A003.c不管制为最大配置不超过4A003.b限值的产品或产品系列“专门设计”的“电子组件”。
text.en: 4A003.c does not control “electronic assemblies” “specially designed” for a product or family of products whose maximum configuration does not exceed the limit of 4A003.b.

text.zh: d. 至f. ［保留］
text.en: d. to f. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 执行模数转换的“电子组件”、模块或设备，见3A002.h。
text.en: For “electronic assemblies,” modules or equipment, performing analog-to-digital conversions, see 3A002.h.

text.zh: g. 为通过提供外部互连而聚合“数字计算机”性能、允许每条链路单向数据速率超过2.0 Gbyte/s的通信而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: g. Equipment “specially designed” for aggregating the performance of “digital computers” by providing external interconnections which allow communications at unidirectional data rates exceeding 2.0 Gbyte/s per link.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 4A003.g不管制内部互连设备（例如背板、总线）、无源互连设备、“网络接入控制器”或“通信通道控制器”。
text.en: 4A003.g does not control internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes, buses) passive interconnection equipment, “network access controllers” or “communication channel controllers”.

text.en: h. through y. [Reserved]

text.zh: 1. 就4A004.a而言，“脉动阵列计算机”是指用户可在逻辑门层面动态控制数据流动和修改的计算机。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 4A004.a, 'systolic array computers' are computers where the flow and modification of the data is dynamically controllable at the logic gate level by the user.

text.zh: 2. 就4A004.b而言，“神经计算机”是为模仿神经元或神经元集合的行为而设计或改装的计算设备，即其特征在于具有根据先前数据调节多个计算部件之间互连权重和数量的硬件能力的计算设备。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 4A004.b, 'neural computers' are computational devices designed or modified to mimic the behavior of a neuron or a collection of neurons, i.e., computational devices which are distinguished by their hardware capability to modulate the weights and numbers of the interconnections of a multiplicity of computational components based on previous data.

text.zh: 3. 就4A004.c而言，“光计算机”是为用光表示数据而设计或改装，且其计算逻辑元件基于直接耦合光学器件的计算机。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 4A004.c, 'optical computers' are computers designed or modified to use light to represent data and whose computational logic elements are based on directly coupled optical devices.

text.zh: a. 下列量子计算机：
text.en: a. Quantum computers, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 支持34个或以上但少于100个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于10^{−4}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.1. Quantum computers supporting 34 or more, but fewer than 100, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 10^{−4};

text.zh: a.2. 支持100个或以上但少于200个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.2. Quantum computers supporting 100 or more, but fewer than 200, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.3. 支持200个或以上但少于350个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于2 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.3. Quantum computers supporting 200 or more, but fewer than 350, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 2 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.4. 支持350个或以上但少于500个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于3 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.4. Quantum computers supporting 350 or more, but fewer than 500, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 3 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.5. 支持500个或以上但少于700个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于4 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.5. Quantum computers supporting 500 or more, but fewer than 700, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 4 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.6. 支持700个或以上但少于1,100个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于5 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.6. Quantum computers supporting 700 or more, but fewer than 1,100, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 5 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.7. 支持1,100个或以上但少于2,000个“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，且“C-NOT误差”小于或等于6 × 10^{−3}的量子计算机；
text.en: a.7. Quantum computers supporting 1,100 or more, but fewer than 2,000, 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits', and having a 'C-NOT error' of less than or equal to 6 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: a.8. 支持2,000个或以上“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”的量子计算机；
text.en: a.8. Quantum computers supporting 2,000 or more 'fully controlled', 'connected' and 'working' 'physical qubits';

text.zh: b. 含有或支持“物理量子比特”阵列，且为4A906.a所列物项“专门设计”的量子比特器件和量子比特电路；
text.en: b. Qubit devices and qubit circuits, containing or supporting arrays of 'physical qubits', and “specially designed” for items specified by 4A906.a;

text.zh: c. 为4A906.a所列物项“专门设计”的量子控制部件和量子测量器件；
text.en: c. Quantum control components and quantum measurement devices, “specially designed” for items specified by 4A906.a;
Note 1:

text.zh: 4A906适用于电路模型（或基于量子门）和单向（或基于测量）的量子计算机。本条目不适用于绝热（或退火）量子计算机。
text.en: 4A906 applies to circuit model (or gate-based) and one-way (or measurement-based) quantum computers. This entry does not apply to adiabatic (or annealing) quantum computers.
Note 2:

text.zh: 4A906所列物项未必在物理上包含任何量子比特。例如，基于光子方案的量子计算机并不永久包含可识别为量子比特的实物。光子量子比特是在计算机运行时生成、随后被舍弃的。
text.en: Items specified by 4A906 may not necessarily physically contain any qubits. For example, quantum computers based on photonic schemes do not permanently contain a physical item that can be identified as a qubit. Instead, the photonic qubits are generated while the computer is operating and then later discarded.
Note 3:

text.zh: 4A906.b所列物项包括半导体、超导和光子量子比特芯片及芯片阵列；表面离子阱阵列；其他量子比特约束技术；以及这些物项之间的相干互连。
text.en: Items specified by 4A906.b include semiconductor, superconducting, and photonic qubit chips and chip arrays; surface ion trap arrays; other qubit confinement technologies; and coherent interconnects between such items.
Note 4:

text.zh: 4A906.c适用于为校准、初始化、操控或测量量子计算机内驻留量子比特而设计的物项。
text.en: 4A906.c applies to items designed for calibrating, initializing, manipulating or measuring the resident qubits of a quantum computer.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就4A906而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 4A906:

text.zh: 1. “物理量子比特”是通过未经纠错的操控和测量来表示量子逻辑基本单元的二能级量子系统。“物理量子比特”有别于逻辑量子比特，后者是由多个“物理量子比特”组成的经纠错量子比特。
text.en: 1. A 'physical qubit' is a two-level quantum system used to represent the elementary unit of quantum logic by means of manipulations and measurements that are not error corrected. 'Physical qubits' are distinguished from logical qubits, in that logical qubits are error-corrected qubits comprised of many 'physical qubits'.

text.zh: 2. “完全受控”是指可根据需要对“物理量子比特”进行校准、初始化、门操作和读出。
text.en: 2. 'Fully controlled' means the 'physical qubit' can be calibrated, initialized, gated, and read out, as necessary.

text.zh: 3. “相连”是指可在可用且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”中任意一对之间执行双量子比特门操作。这不一定意味着全连接。
text.en: 3. 'Connected' means that two-qubit gate operations can be performed between any arbitrary pair of the available 'working' 'physical qubits'. This does not necessarily entail all-to-all connectivity.

text.zh: 4. “正常工作”是指“物理量子比特”按照系统对量子比特操作保真度的规格要求执行通用量子计算任务。
text.en: 4. 'Working' means that the 'physical qubit' performs universal quantum computational work according to the system specifications for qubit operational fidelity.

text.zh: 5. 支持34个或以上“完全受控”、“相连”且“正常工作”的“物理量子比特”，是指量子计算机能够约束、控制、测量和处理34个或以上“物理量子比特”中承载的量子信息。
text.en: 5. Supporting 34 or more 'fully controlled', 'connected', 'working' 'physical qubits' refers to the capability of a quantum computer to confine, control, measure and process the quantum information embodied in 34 or more 'physical qubits'.

text.zh: 6. “C-NOT误差”是最近邻两个“物理量子比特”的受控非（C-NOT）门的平均物理门误差。
text.en: 6. 'C-NOT error' is the average physical gate error for the nearest-neighbor two-'physical qubit' Controlled-NOT (C-NOT) gates.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:
Note 1:

text.zh: 在满足下列条件时，4A994所述“数字计算机”及相关设备的管制状态由其他设备或系统的管制状态决定：
text.en: The control status of the “digital computers” and related equipment described in 4A994 is determined by the control status of other equipment or systems provided:

text.zh: a. “数字计算机”或相关设备为其他设备或系统运行所必不可少；
text.en: a. The “digital computers” or related equipment are essential for the operation of the other equipment or systems;

text.zh: b. “数字计算机”或相关设备不是其他设备或系统的“主要组成部分”；以及
text.en: b. The “digital computers” or related equipment are not a “principal element” of the other equipment or systems; and

text.zh: 特别提示1：为其他设备“专门设计”、且功能限于该其他设备所需功能的“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备，即使超过“主要组成部分”标准，其管制状态仍由该其他设备的管制状态决定。
text.en: N.B. 1: The control status of “signal processing” or “image enhancement” equipment “specially designed” for other equipment with functions limited to those required for the other equipment is determined by the control status of the other equipment even if it exceeds the “principal element” criterion.

text.zh: 特别提示2：用于电信设备的“数字计算机”或相关设备的管制状态，见第5类第1部分（电信）。
text.en: N.B. 2: For the control status of “digital computers” or related equipment for telecommunications equipment, see Category 5, Part 1 (Telecommunications).

text.zh: c. “数字计算机”及相关设备的“技术”由4E确定。
text.en: c. The “technology” for the “digital computers” and related equipment is determined by 4E.

text.zh: a. 额定可在高于343 K（70 °C）的环境温度下运行的电子计算机及相关设备，以及为其配套的“电子组件”和“专门设计”的“零件”及“部件”；
text.en: a. Electronic computers and related equipment, and “electronic assemblies” and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor, rated for operation at an ambient temperature above 343 K (70 °C);

text.zh: b. “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）大于或等于0.0128加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）的“数字计算机”，包括“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备；
text.en: b. “Digital computers”, including equipment of “signal processing” or image enhancement”, having an “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”) equal to or greater than 0.0128 Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT);

text.zh: c. 为通过处理器聚合提升性能而“专门设计”或改装的下列“电子组件”：
text.en: c. “Electronic assemblies” that are “specially designed” or modified to enhance performance by aggregation of processors, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 设计为可按16个或以上处理器的配置进行聚合；
text.en: c.1. Designed to be capable of aggregation in configurations of 16 or more processors;
c.2. [Reserved];
Note 1:

text.zh: 4A994.c仅适用于以未集成的“电子组件”形式装运时，“APP”不超过4A994.b限值的“电子组件”和可编程互连装置。本款不适用于因其设计性质而固有限定为用作4A994.k管制相关设备的“电子组件”。
text.en: 4A994.c applies only to “electronic assemblies” and programmable interconnections with a “APP” not exceeding the limits in 4A994.b, when shipped as unintegrated “electronic assemblies”. It does not apply to “electronic assemblies” inherently limited by nature of their design for use as related equipment controlled by 4A994.k.
Note 2:

text.zh: 4A994.c不管制为最大配置不超过4A994.b限值的产品或产品系列“专门设计”的任何“电子组件”。
text.en: 4A994.c does not control any “electronic assembly” “specially designed” for a product or family of products whose maximum configuration does not exceed the limits of 4A994.b.

text.zh: d. ［保留］；
text.en: d. [Reserved];

text.zh: e. ［保留］；
text.en: e. [Reserved];

text.zh: f. “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）大于或等于0.0128加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）的“信号处理”或“图像增强”设备；
text.en: f. Equipment for “signal processing” or “image enhancement” having an “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”) equal to or greater than 0.0128 Weighted TeraFLOPS WT;

text.zh: g. ［保留］；
text.en: g. [Reserved];

text.zh: h. ［保留］；
text.en: h. [Reserved];

text.zh: i. 含有超过5A991限值的“终端接口设备”的设备；
text.en: i. Equipment containing “terminal interface equipment” exceeding the limits in 5A991;

text.zh: j. 为提供“数字计算机”或相关设备的外部互连、允许数据速率超过80 Mbyte/s的通信而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: j. Equipment “specially designed” to provide external interconnection of “digital computers” or associated equipment that allows communications at data rates exceeding 80 Mbyte/s.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 4A994.j不管制内部互连设备（例如背板、总线）、无源互连设备、“网络接入控制器”或“通信通道控制器”。
text.en: 4A994.j does not control internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes, buses) passive interconnection equipment, “network access controllers” or “communication channel controllers”.

text.zh: k. “混合计算机”、其“电子组件”以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，含有同时具有以下全部特性的模数转换器：
text.en: k. “Hybrid computers” and “electronic assemblies” and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor containing analog-to-digital converters having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: k.1. 32个或以上通道；以及
text.en: k.1. 32 channels or more; and

text.zh: k.2. 分辨率为14位（另加符号位）或以上，转换速率为200,000次转换/秒或以上。
text.en: k.2. A resolution of 14 bit (plus sign bit) or more with a conversion rate of 200,000 conversions/s or more.

text.zh: l. 其他未列明的计算机、“电子组件”和“部件”，含有集成电路且其中任一集成电路达到或超过ECCN 3A991.p的限值。
text.en: l. Computers, “electronic assemblies,” and “components,” n.e.s., containing integrated circuits, any of which meets or exceeds the limit of ECCN 3A991.p.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就4A994.l而言，计算机包括“数字计算机”、“混合计算机”和模拟计算机。
text.en: For the purposes of 4A994.l, computers include “digital computers,” “hybrid computers,” and analog computers.

text.zh: 相关定义：“全局中断延迟时间”是计算机系统识别由事件引起的中断、处理中断，以及执行上下文切换至等待该中断的另一个内存驻留任务所需的时间。
text.en: Related Definitions: “Global interrupt latency time” is the time taken by the computer system to recognize an interrupt due to the event, service the interrupt and perform a context switch to an alternate memory-resident task waiting on the interrupt.

text.zh: 物项：a. 运用数学和分析方法，且为具有超过500,000条“源代码”指令的“程序”而设计或改装的“程序”证明和验证“软件”；
text.en: Items: a. “Program” proof and validation “software” using mathematical and analytical techniques and designed or modified for “programs” having more than 500,000 “source code” instructions;

text.zh: b. 可根据从《商业管制清单》所述外部传感器在线采集的数据自动生成“源代码”的“软件”；或
text.en: b. “Software” allowing the automatic generation of “source codes” from data acquired online from external sensors described in the Commerce Control List; or

text.zh: c. 为保证“全局中断延迟时间”小于20微秒的“实时处理”设备“专门设计”的操作系统“软件”。
text.en: c. Operating system “software” “specially designed” for “real-time processing” equipment that guarantees a “global interrupt latency time” of less than 20 microseconds.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就4E091而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 4E091:

text.zh: 1. “参数”指训练期间学习得到的任何数值（例如网络权重、偏置等）。人工智能模型的“参数”也称模型权重。
text.en: 1. 'Parameters' refers to any value learned during training (e.g., network weights, biases, etc.). 'Parameters' for an artificial intelligence model are also known as model weights.

text.zh: 2. “运算”指预训练及任何后续训练（例如对预训练模型进行微调）所使用的数学运算，但不包括输入训练数据的收集和整理。训练“运算”应计入执行预训练和后续训练过程所有步骤所需的运算，包括所有相关层的前向传播和反向传播、池化及卷积所需的运算，不考虑具体实现方式和硬件限制，并适用于所有相关运算。例如，考虑一个由单个全连接层构成、具有I个输入神经元和O个输出神经元、无偏置并采用反向传播训练的模型。该模型共有N = I * O个学习参数。每次前向传播需要N次乘加运算，或（假设采用浮点运算）2N FLOP。每次反向传播需要2N次乘加运算，或4N FLOP。因此，每个训练数据点总共需要6N FLOP。在大小为D的数据集上训练需要总计6ND FLOP。
text.en: 2. 'Operations' refers to mathematical operations used for pre-training and any subsequent training, such as fine-tuning the pre-trained model, but does not include the collection and curation of the input training data. Training 'operations' should account for operations required to perform all steps in the pre-training and subsequent training process, including those for forward and backward propagation for all relevant layers, pooling, and convolutions, regardless of the implementation and hardware limitations, and applied to all relevant operations. For example, consider a model composed of a single densely connected layer with I input neurons, O output neurons, and no biases being trained with backpropagation. Such a model would have a total of N = I * O learned parameters. Each forward pass would require N multiply accumulate operations, or (assuming floating point arithmetic) 2N FLOP. Each backward pass would require 2N multiply accumulate operations, or 4N FLOP. Then, in total, each training data point would require 6N FLOP. Training on a data set of size D would require 6ND total FLOP.

text.zh: 3. 如果超过百分之十的“运算”涉及使用尚未按第734.7(a)条定义“公开”、且由单一数据生成模型生成的数据进行训练，则应计入该数据生成模型生成数据所使用的“运算”；如果该数据生成模型的“参数”尚未“公开”，还应计入训练该数据生成模型所使用的训练“运算”。单一数据生成模型包括同一模型的变体，例如不同检查点或经微调的变体。如果使用多个“参数”尚未“公开”的模型生成的数据用于超过百分之十的训练“运算”，则仅计入其中使用训练“运算”最多的数据生成模型的训练“运算”。任何实际训练“运算”不得重复计数；因此，如果数据生成模型A用于训练数据生成模型B和C，而模型B和C用于训练模型D，则训练A的运算仅向模型D的运算次数中加入一次。
text.en: 3. If more than ten percent of the 'operations' involve training on data that was not “published” as defined in § 734.7(a) and was generated by a single data-generation model, then 'operations' the data-generation model used to generate the data should be counted, and if the data-generation model's 'parameters' were not “published,” then the training 'operations' used to train the data-generating model should be counted as well. A single data-generation model includes variants of the same model, such as different checkpoints or fine-tuned variants. If multiple models with 'parameters' that were not “published” were used to generate data used for more than ten percent of the training 'operations,' then only the training 'operations' of the data-generation model using the most training 'operations' should be counted. No actual training 'operation' should be counted more than once, so if data-generation model A is used to train data-generation model B and data-generation model C, and models B and C are used to train model D, then the operations to train A are only added to the number of operations for model D once.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 根据EAR第734.7条，4E091不管制已按第734.7(a)条定义“公开”的任何人工智能模型的“参数”。4E091也不管制从参数已“公开”的模型衍生的任何人工智能模型的“参数”，但该模型的衍生过程使用的额外训练“运算”超过2.5 × 10^{25}次“运算”或超过注2定义的训练“运算”的25%（以较高者为准）的除外。
text.en: 1. In accordance with § 734.7 of the EAR, 4E091 does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model that have been “published” as defined in § 734.7(a). 4E091 also does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model derived from a model whose parameters have been 'published,' except where the model has been derived using additional training 'operations' that constitute more than 2.5 × 10^{25} 'operations' or more than 25 percent of the training 'operations' defined in Note 2, whichever is higher.

text.zh: 2. 4E091不管制下述任何人工智能模型的“参数”：其训练所使用的“运算”少于按最高效的已“公开”人工智能模型训练方法、训练一个根据广泛使用的基准综合评估能力等同于已按EAR第734.7(a)条定义“公开”的最先进人工智能模型所需的运算次数。为确保该排除规定的确定性，所需“运算”次数不应因算法改进而减少。
text.en: 2. 4E091 does not control the 'parameters' of any artificial intelligence model trained utilizing fewer 'operations' than the number needed, based on the most efficient “published” methods to train artificial intelligence models, to train an artificial intelligence model as capable, according to an aggregate of widely used benchmarks, as the most advanced artificial intelligence model that has been “published” as defined in § 734.7(a) of the EAR. To provide certainty for this exclusion, the number of 'operations' needed should not decrease with algorithmic improvements.

text.zh: 2.a. 出口商可通过以下任一方式确定AI模型是否属于该排除范围：
text.en: 2.a. An exporter may determine whether an AI model falls within this exclusion by either:

text.zh: 2.a.1. 依据BIS公布的指引，或美国AI安全研究所和能源部出具的技术意见（如已公布此类意见）自行分类；或
text.en: 2.a.1. Self classifying by relying on guidance published by BIS or technical opinions issued by the U.S. AI Safety Institute and the Department of Energy, should such opinions have been published, or

text.zh: 2.a.2. 按照EAR第748.1条和第748.3条的程序向BIS提出分类请求。
text.en: 2.a.2. A classification request to BIS in accordance with the procedures in §§ 748.1 and 748.3 of the EAR.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 测向“设备”（包括ECCN 5A001.e中的设备类型）及任何其他“受ITAR管辖”的军用或情报电子“设备”的管制，见USML第XI类。(2) 5A001.f及.h定义且受ITAR管辖的电子攻击和干扰“设备”的管制，见USML第XI(a)(4)(iii)类。(3) 将抗辐射加固集成电路装入ECCN 5A991所列或指定为EAR99的电信设备，这一行为本身并不使该电信设备达到ECCN 5A001.a.2款的指标。(4) 另见ECCN 5A101、5A980和5A991。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category XI for controls on direction-finding “equipment” including types of “equipment” in ECCN 5A001.e and any other military or intelligence electronic “equipment” that is “subject to the ITAR.” (2) See USML Category XI(a)(4)(iii) for controls on electronic attack and jamming “equipment” defined in 5A001.f and .h that are subject to the ITAR. (3) The act of incorporating a radiation hardened integrated circuit into telecommunications equipment that is specified under ECCN 5A991 or designated as EAR99 does not, in and of itself, cause the telecommunications equipment to meet the specifications of ECCN paragraph 5A001.a.2. (4) See also ECCNs 5A101, 5A980, and 5A991.

text.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的任何类型电信设备：
text.en: a. Any type of telecommunications equipment having any of the following characteristics, functions or features:

text.zh: a.1. 为承受核爆炸引起的瞬态电子效应或电磁脉冲效应而“专门设计”；
text.en: a.1. “Specially designed” to withstand transitory electronic effects or electromagnetic pulse effects, both arising from a nuclear explosion;

text.zh: a.2. 经专门加固以承受伽马、中子或离子辐射；
text.en: a.2. Specially hardened to withstand gamma, neutron or ion radiation;

text.zh: a.3. 为在低于218 K（−55 °C）温度下运行而“专门设计”；或
text.en: a.3. “Specially designed” to operate below 218 K (−55 °C); or

text.zh: a.4. 为在高于397 K（124 °C）温度下运行而“专门设计”；
text.en: a.4. “Specially designed” to operate above 397 K (124 °C);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.a.3和5A001.a.4仅适用于电子设备。
text.en: 5A001.a.3 and 5A001.a.4 apply only to electronic equipment.

text.zh: b. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的电信系统和设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”和“附件”：
text.en: b. Telecommunication systems and equipment, and “specially designed” “components” and “accessories” therefor, having any of the following characteristics, functions or features:

text.zh: b.1. 具有下列任一特性的水下无缆通信系统：
text.en: b.1 Being underwater untethered communications systems having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 声载波频率处于20 kHz至60 kHz范围之外；
text.en: b.1.a. An acoustic carrier frequency outside the range from 20 kHz to 60 kHz;

text.zh: b.1.b. 使用低于30 kHz的电磁载波频率；或
text.en: b.1.b. Using an electromagnetic carrier frequency below 30 kHz; or

text.zh: b.1.c. 使用电子波束操纵技术；或
text.en: b.1.c. Using electronic beam steering techniques; or

text.zh: b.1.d. 在“局域网”中使用输出波长大于400 nm且小于700 nm的“激光器”或发光二极管（LED）；
text.en: b.1.d. Using “lasers” or light-emitting diodes (LEDs), with an output wavelength greater than 400 nm and less than 700 nm, in a “local area network”;

text.zh: b.2. 工作在1.5 MHz至87.5 MHz频段且同时具有以下全部特性的无线电设备：
text.en: b.2. Being radio equipment operating in the 1.5 MHz to 87.5 MHz band and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 自动预测和选择每通道的频率及“总数字传输速率”以优化传输；以及
text.en: b.2.a.. Automatically predicting and selecting frequencies and “total digital transfer rates” per channel to optimize the transmission; and

text.zh: b.2.b. 采用线性功率放大器配置，能够在一个倍频程或以上的“瞬时带宽”内，同时支持多个信号；在1.5 MHz或以上但低于30 MHz的频率范围内输出功率为1 kW或以上，或在30 MHz或以上但不超过87.5 MHz的频率范围内输出功率为250 W或以上；且输出谐波及失真含量优于−80 dB；
text.en: b.2.b. Incorporating a linear power amplifier configuration having a capability to support multiple signals simultaneously at an output power of 1 kW or more in the frequency range of 1.5 MHz or more but less than 30 MHz, or 250 W or more in the frequency range of 30 MHz or more but not exceeding 87.5 MHz, over an “instantaneous bandwidth” of one octave or more and with an output harmonic and distortion content of better than −80 dB;

text.zh: b.3. 采用“扩频”技术（包括“跳频”技术）、不受5A001.b.4管制且具有下列任一特性的无线电设备：
text.en: b.3. Being radio equipment employing “spread spectrum” techniques, including “frequency hopping” techniques, not controlled in 5A001.b.4 and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a. 用户可编程扩频码；或
text.en: b.3.a. User programmable spreading codes; or

text.zh: b.3.b. 总发射带宽为任一信息通道带宽的100倍或以上，且超过50 kHz；
text.en: b.3.b. A total transmitted bandwidth which is 100 or more times the bandwidth of any one information channel and in excess of 50 kHz;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.b.3.b不管制为与下列任一系统或设备配合使用而“专门设计”的无线电设备：
text.en: 5A001.b.3.b does not control radio equipment “specially designed” for use with any of the following:

text.zh: a. 民用蜂窝无线电通信系统；或
text.en: a. Civil cellular radio-communications systems; or

text.zh: b. 商业民用电信的固定或移动卫星地面站。
text.en: b. Fixed or mobile satellite Earth stations for commercial civil telecommunications.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.b.3不管制工作输出功率为1 W或以下的设备。
text.en: 5A001.b.3 does not control equipment operating at an output power of 1 W or less.

text.zh: b.4. 采用超宽带调制技术，具有用户可编程信道化码、扰码或网络识别码，且具有下列任一特性的无线电设备：
text.en: b.4. Being radio equipment employing ultra-wideband modulation techniques, having user programmable channelizing codes, scrambling codes, or network identification codes and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 带宽超过500 MHz；或
text.en: b.4.a. A bandwidth exceeding 500 MHz; or

text.zh: b.4.b. “相对带宽”为20%或以上；
text.en: b.4.b. A “fractional bandwidth” of 20% or more;

text.zh: b.5. 同时具有以下全部特性的数字控制无线电接收机：
text.en: b.5. Being digitally controlled radio receivers having all of the following:

text.zh: b.5.a. 超过1,000个通道；
text.en: b.5.a. More than 1,000 channels;

text.zh: b.5.b. “信道切换时间”小于1 ms；
text.en: b.5.b. A 'channel switching time' of less than 1 ms;

text.zh: b.5.c. 自动搜索或扫描部分电磁频谱；以及
text.en: b.5.c. Automatic searching or scanning of a part of the electromagnetic spectrum; and

text.zh: b.5.d. 识别接收信号或发射机类型；或
text.en: b.5.d. Identification of the received signals or the type of transmitter; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.b.5不管制为与民用蜂窝无线电通信系统配合使用而“专门设计”的无线电设备。
text.en: 5A001.b.5 does not control radio equipment “specially designed” for use with civil cellular radio-communications systems.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A001.b.5.b而言，“信道切换时间”是从一个接收频率切换到另一个接收频率，达到最终规定接收频率或其±0.05%以内所需的时间（即延迟）。规定频率范围小于中心频率±0.05%的物项，被定义为不具备信道频率切换能力。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A001.b.5.b, 'channel switching time' means the time (i.e., delay) to change from one receiving frequency to another, to arrive at or within ±0.05% of the final specified receiving frequency. Items having a specified frequency range of less than ±0.05% around their center frequency are defined to be incapable of channel frequency switching.

text.zh: b.6. 采用数字“信号处理”功能，以低于700 bit/s的速率提供“语音编码”输出。
text.en: b.6. Employing functions of digital “signal processing” to provide 'voice coding' output at rates of less than 700 bit/s.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 对于可变速率“语音编码”，5A001.b.6适用于连续语音的“语音编码”输出。
text.en: 1. For variable rate 'voice coding', 5A001.b.6 applies to the 'voice coding' output of continuous speech.

text.zh: 2. 就5A001.b.6而言，“语音编码”是对人类语音进行采样，然后考虑人类语音特定特征，将这些人类语音样本转换为数字信号的技术。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 5A001.b.6, 'voice coding' is defined as the technique to take samples of human voice and then convert these samples of human voice into a digital signal taking into account specific characteristics of human speech.

text.zh: c. 长度超过500 m，且制造商规定能够承受2 × 10^{9} N/m^{2}或以上“验证试验”拉伸应力的光纤；
text.en: c. Optical fibers of more than 500 m in length and specified by the manufacturer as being capable of withstanding a 'proof test' tensile stress of 2 × 10^{9} N/m^{2} or more;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 水下脐带缆见8A002.a.3。
text.en: For underwater umbilical cables, see 8A002.a.3.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A001.c而言，“验证试验”是在线或离线生产筛选测试：光纤以2至5 m/s的运行速度通过直径约150 mm的绞盘时，对0.5至3 m长度的光纤动态施加规定拉伸应力。环境温度标称值为293 K（20 °C），相对湿度为40%。可采用等效国家标准实施验证试验。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A001.c, 'proof test' is the on-line or off-line production screen testing that dynamically applies a prescribed tensile stress over a 0.5 to 3 m length of fiber at a running rate of 2 to 5 m/s while passing between capstans approximately 150 mm in diameter. The ambient temperature is a nominal 293 K (20 °C) and relative humidity 40%. Equivalent national standards may be used for executing the proof test.

text.zh: d. 下列“电子可操纵相控阵天线”：
text.en: d. “Electronically steerable phased array antennae” as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 额定工作频率高于31.8 GHz但不超过57 GHz，且有效辐射功率（ERP）大于或等于+20 dBm（有效全向辐射功率〔EIRP〕为22.15 dBm）；
text.en: d.1. Rated for operation above 31.8 GHz, but not exceeding 57 GHz, and having an Effective Radiated Power (ERP) equal to or greater than +20 dBm (22.15 dBm Effective Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP));

text.zh: d.2. 额定工作频率高于57 GHz但不超过66 GHz，且ERP大于或等于+24 dBm（EIRP为26.15 dBm）；
text.en: d.2. Rated for operation above 57 GHz, but not exceeding 66 GHz, and having an ERP equal to or greater than +24 dBm (26.15 dBm EIRP);

text.zh: d.3. 额定工作频率高于66 GHz但不超过90 GHz，且ERP大于或等于+20 dBm（EIRP为22.15 dBm）；
text.en: d.3. Rated for operation above 66 GHz, but not exceeding 90 GHz, and having an ERP equal to or greater than +20 dBm (22.15 dBm EIRP);

text.zh: d.4. 额定工作频率高于90 GHz；
text.en: d.4. Rated for operation above 90 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: 5A001.d不管制用于仪表符合ICAO微波着陆系统（MLS）标准的着陆系统的“电子可操纵相控阵天线”。
text.en: 5A001.d does not control 'electronically steerable phased array antennae' for landing systems with instruments meeting ICAO standards covering Microwave Landing Systems (MLS).
Note 2:

text.zh: 5A001.d不适用于为下列任一用途而“专门设计”的天线：
text.en: 5A001.d does not apply to antennae “specially designed” for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 民用蜂窝或WLAN无线电通信系统；
text.en: a. Civil cellular or WLAN radio-communications systems;

text.zh: b. IEEE 802.15或无线HDMI；或
text.en: b. IEEE 802.15 or wireless HDMI; or

text.zh: c. 商业民用电信的固定或移动卫星地面站。
text.en: c. Fixed or mobile satellite earth stations for commercial civil telecommunications.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A001.d而言，“电子可操纵相控阵天线”是通过相位耦合形成波束（即波束方向由辐射单元的复数激励系数控制），且可通过施加电信号在发射和接收时改变波束方位角或俯仰角或两者的天线。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A001.d, 'electronically steerable phased array antenna' is an antenna which forms a beam by means of phase coupling, (i.e., the beam direction is controlled by the complex excitation coefficients of the radiating elements) and the direction of that beam can be varied (both in transmission and reception) in azimuth or in elevation, or both, by application of an electrical signal.

text.zh: e. 工作频率高于30 MHz且同时具有以下全部特性的无线电测向设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: e. Radio direction finding equipment operating at frequencies above 30 MHz and having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: e.1. “瞬时带宽”为10 MHz或以上；以及
text.en: e.1. “Instantaneous bandwidth” of 10 MHz or more; and

text.zh: e.2. 能够对信号持续时间小于1 ms的非合作无线电发射机确定方位线（LOB）；
text.en: e.2. Capable of finding a Line Of Bearing (LOB) to non-cooperating radio transmitters with a signal duration of less than 1 ms;

text.zh: f. 下列移动电信截获或干扰设备及其监测设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: f. Mobile telecommunications interception or jamming equipment, and monitoring equipment therefor, as follows, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: f.1. 为提取通过空中接口传输的语音或数据而设计的截获设备；
text.en: f.1. Interception equipment designed for the extraction of voice or data, transmitted over the air interface;

text.zh: f.2. 5A001.f.1未列明、为提取通过空中接口传输的客户端设备或用户标识符（例如IMSI、TIMSI或IMEI）、信令或其他元数据而设计的截获设备；
text.en: f.2. Interception equipment not specified in 5A001.f.1, designed for the extraction of client device or subscriber identifiers (e.g., IMSI, TIMSI or IMEI), signaling, or other metadata transmitted over the air interface;

text.zh: f.3. 为故意且有选择地干扰、拒止、抑制、降低或诱骗移动电信服务而“专门设计”或改装，并执行下列任一功能的干扰设备：
text.en: f.3. Jamming equipment “specially designed” or modified to intentionally and selectively interfere with, deny, inhibit, degrade or seduce mobile telecommunication services and performing any of the following:

text.zh: f.3.a. 模拟无线接入网络（RAN）设备的功能；
text.en: f.3.a. Simulate the functions of Radio Access Network (RAN) equipment;

text.zh: f.3.b. 检测并利用所采用移动电信协议（例如GSM）的特定特征；或
text.en: f.3.b. Detect and exploit specific characteristics of the mobile telecommunications protocol employed (e.g., GSM); or

text.zh: f.3.c. 利用所采用移动电信协议（例如GSM）的特定特征；
text.en: f.3.c. Exploit specific characteristics of the mobile telecommunications protocol employed (e.g., GSM);

text.zh: f.4. 为识别5A001.f.1、5A001.f.2或5A001.f.3所列物项运行而设计或改装的射频（RF）监测设备。
text.en: f.4. Radio Frequency (RF) monitoring equipment designed or modified to identify the operation of items specified in 5A001.f.1, 5A001.f.2 or 5A001.f.3.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.f.1和5A001.f.2不适用于下列任一设备：
text.en: 5A001.f.1 and 5A001.f.2 do not apply to any of the following:

text.zh: a. 为截获模拟专用移动无线电（PMR）、IEEE 802.11 WLAN而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: a. Equipment “specially designed” for the interception of analog Private Mobile Radio (PMR), IEEE 802.11 WLAN;

text.zh: b. 为移动电信网络运营商设计的设备；或
text.en: b. Equipment designed for mobile telecommunications network operators; or

text.zh: c. 为“开发”或“生产”移动电信设备或系统设计的设备。
text.en: c. Equipment designed for the “development” or “production” of mobile telecommunications equipment or systems.

text.zh: 特别提示1：
另见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第120至130部分）。5A001.f.1所列物项（包括此前由5A001.i列明的物项），另见5A980及《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
text.en: See also the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). For items specified by 5A001.f.1 (including as previously specified by 5A001.i), see also 5A980 and the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: 特别提示2：
无线电接收机见5A001.b.5。
text.en: For radio receivers see 5A001.b.5.

text.zh: g. 为通过测量非雷达发射机产生的环境射频辐射反射来探测和跟踪移动目标而“专门设计”的无源相干定位（PCL）系统或设备。
text.en: g. Passive Coherent Location (PCL) systems or equipment, “specially designed” for detecting and tracking moving objects by measuring reflections of ambient radio frequency emissions, supplied by non-radar transmitters.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5A001.g而言，非雷达发射机可包括商业无线电、电视或蜂窝电信基站。
text.en: For the purposes of 5A001.g, non-radar transmitters may include commercial radio, television or cellular telecommunications base stations.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.g不管制：
text.en: 5A001.g. does not control:

text.zh: a. 射电天文设备；或
text.en: a. Radio-astronomical equipment; or

text.zh: b. 需要目标发出任何无线电信号的系统或设备。
text.en: b. Systems or equipment, that require any radio transmission from the target.

text.zh: h. 下列反简易爆炸装置（IED）设备及相关设备：
text.en: h. Counter Improvised Explosive Device (IED) equipment and related equipment, as follows:

text.zh: h.1. 未由5A001.f列明、为提前引爆或阻止引爆简易爆炸装置（IED）而设计或改装的射频（RF）发射设备；
text.en: h.1. Radio Frequency (RF) transmitting equipment, not specified by 5A001.f, designed or modified for prematurely activating or preventing the initiation of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs);

text.zh: h.2. 采用相关技术，以实现在与同址5A001.h.1所列设备正在发射的相同频率信道上进行无线电通信的设备。
text.en: h.2. Equipment using techniques designed to enable radio communications in the same frequency channels on which co-located equipment specified by 5A001.h.1 is transmitting.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 另见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第120至130部分）第XI类。
text.en: See also Category XI of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130).

text.zh: i. [保留]
text.en: i. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 此前由5A001.i列明的物项，见5A001.f.1。
text.en: See 5A001.f.1 for items previously specified by 5A001.i.

text.zh: j. 同时具有以下全部特性的IP网络通信监视系统或设备，以及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: j. IP network communications surveillance systems or equipment, and “specially designed” components therefor, having all of the following:

text.zh: j.1. 在运营商级IP网络（例如国家级IP骨干网）上执行以下全部操作：
text.en: j.1. Performing all of the following on a carrier class IP network (e.g., national grade IP backbone):

text.zh: j.1.a. 应用层分析（例如开放系统互连〔OSI〕模型〔ISO/IEC 7498-1〕的第7层）；
text.en: j.1.a. Analysis at the application layer (e.g., Layer 7 of Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model (ISO/IEC 7498-1));

text.zh: j.1.b. 提取选定元数据和应用内容（例如语音、视频、消息、附件）；以及
text.en: j.1.b. Extraction of selected metadata and application content (e.g., voice, video, messages, attachments); and

text.zh: j.1.c. 对提取数据建立索引；以及
text.en: j.1.c. Indexing of extracted data; and

text.zh: j.2. 为执行以下全部操作而“专门设计”：
text.en: j.2. Being “specially designed” to carry out all of the following:

text.zh: j.2.a. 基于“硬选择标识符”执行搜索；以及
text.en: j.2.a. Execution of searches on the basis of “hard selectors”; and

text.zh: j.2.b. 绘制个人或群体的关系网络。
text.en: j.2.b. Mapping of the relational network of an individual or of a group of people.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A001.j不适用于为下列任一用途而“专门设计”的“系统”或“设备”：
text.en: 5A001.j does not apply to “systems” or “equipment”, “specially designed” for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 营销目的；
text.en: a. Marketing purpose;

text.zh: b. 网络服务质量（QoS）；或
text.en: b. Network Quality of Service (QoS); or

text.zh: c. 体验质量（QoE）。
text.en: c. Quality of Experience (QoE).

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 另见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第120至130部分）。USML第XI(b)类所述国防物品“受ITAR管辖”。
text.en: See also the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). Defense articles described in USML Category XI(b) are “subject to the ITAR.”

title.zh: 为最大“航程”大于或等于300 km的无人航空器（包括巡航导弹、靶机和侦察无人机）或火箭系统（包括弹道导弹、航天运载火箭和探空火箭）设计或改装的遥测和遥控设备，包括地面设备。
title.en: Telemetering and telecontrol equipment, including ground equipment, designed or modified for unmanned aerial vehicle (including cruise missiles, target drones, and reconnaissance drones) or rocket systems (including ballistic missiles, space launch vehicles, and sounding rockets) capable of a maximum “range” equal to or greater than 300 km.

summary.zh: 为最大“航程”大于或等于300 km的无人航空器（包括巡航导弹、靶机和侦察无人机）或火箭系统（包括弹道导弹、航天运载火箭和探空火箭）设计或改装的遥测和遥控设备，包括地面设备。
summary.en: Telemetering and telecontrol equipment, including ground equipment, designed or modified for unmanned aerial vehicle (including cruise missiles, target drones, and reconnaissance drones) or rocket systems (including ballistic missiles, space launch vehicles, and sounding rockets)

text.zh: 5A101 为最大“航程”大于或等于300 km的无人航空器（包括巡航导弹、靶机和侦察无人机）或火箭系统（包括弹道导弹、航天运载火箭和探空火箭）设计或改装的遥测和遥控设备，包括地面设备。
text.en: 5A101 Telemetering and telecontrol equipment, including ground equipment, designed or modified for unmanned aerial vehicle (including cruise missiles, target drones, and reconnaissance drones) or rocket systems (including ballistic missiles, space launch vehicles, and sounding rockets) capable of a maximum “range” equal to or greater than 300 km.

text.en: Items: The list of items controlled is contained in the ECCN heading.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A101不管制：
text.en: 5A101 does not control:

text.zh: 1. 为遥控娱乐用模型飞机、船或车辆而“专门设计”，且在500米距离处电场强度不超过200微伏/米的遥控设备；
text.en: 1. Telecontrol equipment “specially designed” to be used for remote control of recreational model planes, boats or vehicles and having an electric field strength of not more than 200 microvolts per meter at a distance of 500 meters;

text.zh: 2. 为有人驾驶航空器或卫星设计或改装的设备；
text.en: 2. Equipment designed or modified for manned aircraft or satellites;

text.zh: 3. 为陆地或海上应用设计或改装的地面设备；
text.en: 3. Ground based equipment designed or modified for terrestrial or marine applications;

text.zh: 4. 为商业、民用或生命安全（例如数据完整性或飞行安全）全球导航卫星系统服务设计的设备。
text.en: 4. Equipment designed for commercial, civil, or safety of life (e.g., data integrity or flight safety) Global Navigation Satellite System services.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: ECCN 5A101不包括并非为最大“航程”大于或等于300 km的无人航空器（包括巡航导弹、靶机和侦察无人机）或火箭系统（包括弹道导弹、航天运载火箭和探空火箭）设计或改装的物项（例如设计上仅限接收且设计用于个人计算机的遥测电路板）。
text.en: ECCN 5A101 does not include items not designed or modified for unmanned aerial vehicles (including cruise missiles, target drones, and reconnaissance drones) or rocket systems (including ballistic missiles, space launch vehicles and sounding rockets) capable of a maximum “range” equal to or greater than 300km (e.g., telemetry circuit cards limited by design to reception only and designed for use in personal computers).

title.zh: 为军事应用“专门设计”且未列于USML任何类别的电信设备，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“部件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，受ECCN 3A611管制。

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) “异步传输模式”（“ATM”）是将信息组织成信元的传输模式；其异步性体现在信元的重复出现取决于所需或瞬时比特率。(2) “一个话音信道的带宽”是指按CCITT建议G.151定义、设计为在一个3,100 Hz话音信道内工作的数据通信设备。(3) “通信通道控制器”是控制同步或异步数字信息流的物理接口，是可集成到计算机或电信设备中以提供通信接入的组件。(4) “数据报”是自包含的独立数据实体，携带足够的信息，使其可从源数据终端设备路由至目的数据终端设备，而不依赖此前该源、目的数据终端设备与传输网络之间的交互。(5) “快速选择”是适用于虚呼叫的一项功能，允许数据终端设备扩大在呼叫建立和拆除“分组”中传输数据的能力，超出虚呼叫的基本能力。(6) “网关”是由设备和“软件”的任意组合实现的一种功能，用于将一个系统中表示、处理或传送信息的约定，转换为另一系统中相应但不同的约定。(7) “综合业务数字网”（ISDN）是统一的端到端数字网络，其中源自所有通信类型（例如语音、文本、数据、静态及动态图像）的数据，从交换机中的一个端口（终端）经一条接入线与用户双向传输。(8) “分组”是作为一个整体交换的一组二进制数字，包括数据和呼叫控制信号。数据、呼叫控制信号以及可能的差错控制信息按规定格式排列。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Asynchronous transfer mode” (“ATM”) is a transfer mode in which the information is organized into cells; it is asynchronous in the sense that the recurrence of cells depends on the required or instantaneous bit rate. (2) “Bandwidth of one voice channel” is data communication equipment designed to operate in one voice channel of 3,100 Hz, as defined in CCITT Recommendation G.151. (3) “Communications channel controller” is the physical interface that controls the flow of synchronous or asynchronous digital information. It is an assembly that can be integrated into computer or telecommunications equipment to provide communications access. (4) “Datagram” is a self-contained, independent entity of data carrying sufficient information to be routed from the source to the destination data terminal equipment without reliance on earlier exchanges between this source and destination data terminal equipment and the transporting network. (5) “Fast select” is a facility applicable to virtual calls that allows data terminal equipment to expand the possibility to transmit data in call set-up and clearing “packets” beyond the basic capabilities of a virtual call. (6) “Gateway” is the function, realized by any combination of equipment and “software”, to carry out the conversion of conventions for representing, processing or communicating information used on one system into the corresponding, but different conventions used in another system. (7) “Integrated Services Digital Network” (ISDN) is a unified end-to-end digital network, in which data originating from all types of communication (e.g., voice, text, data, still and moving pictures) are transmitted from one port (terminal) in the exchange (switch) over one access line to and from the subscriber. (8) “Packet” is a group of binary digits including data and call control signals that is switched as a composite whole. The data, call control signals, and possible error control information are arranged in a specified format.

text.zh: 物项：a. 不受5A001.a管制、为在219 K（−54 °C）至397 K（124 °C）温度范围之外运行而“专门设计”的任何类型电信设备。
text.en: Items: a. Any type of telecommunications equipment, not controlled by 5A001.a, “specially designed” to operate outside the temperature range from 219 K (−54 °C) to 397 K (124 °C).

text.zh: b. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的电信传输设备和系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“部件”和“附件”：
text.en: b. Telecommunication transmission equipment and systems, and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor, having any of the following characteristics, functions or features:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 电信传输设备：
text.en: Telecommunication transmission equipment:

text.zh: a. 分为以下类别或其组合：
text.en: a. Categorized as follows, or combinations thereof:

text.zh: 1. 无线电设备（例如发射机、接收机和收发机）；
text.en: 1. Radio equipment (e.g., transmitters, receivers and transceivers);

text.zh: 2. 线路终端设备；
text.en: 2. Line terminating equipment;

text.zh: 3. 中间放大设备；
text.en: 3. Intermediate amplifier equipment;

text.zh: 4. 中继设备；
text.en: 4. Repeater equipment;

text.zh: 5. 再生设备；
text.en: 5. Regenerator equipment;

text.zh: 6. 转换编码器（转码器）；
text.en: 6. Translation encoders (transcoders);

text.zh: 7. 复用设备（包括统计复用）；
text.en: 7. Multiplex equipment (statistical mutiplex included);

text.zh: 8. 调制器/解调器（调制解调器）；
text.en: 8. Modulators/demodulators (modems);

text.zh: 9. 转换复用设备（见CCITT建议G701）；
text.en: 9. Transmultiplex equipment (see CCITT Rec. G701);

text.zh: 10. “存储程序控制”的数字交叉连接设备；
text.en: 10. “Stored program controlled” digital crossconnection equipment;

text.zh: 11. “网关”和网桥；
text.en: 11. “Gateways” and bridges;

text.zh: 12. “介质接入单元”；以及
text.en: 12. “Media access units”; and

text.zh: b. 设计为通过下列任一介质进行单通道或多通道通信：
text.en: b. Designed for use in single or multi-channel communication via any of the following:

text.zh: 1. 导线（线路）；
text.en: 1. Wire (line);

text.zh: 2. 同轴电缆；
text.en: 2. Coaxial cable;

text.zh: 3. 光缆；
text.en: 3. Optical fiber cable;

text.zh: 4. 电磁辐射；或
text.en: 4. Electromagnetic radiation; or

text.zh: 5. 水下声波传播。
text.en: 5. Underwater acoustic wave propagation.

text.zh: b.1. 采用数字技术（包括对模拟信号进行数字处理），且设计为在最高复用级的“数字传输速率”超过45 Mbit/s，或“总数字传输速率”超过90 Mbit/s的条件下运行；
text.en: b.1. Employing digital techniques, including digital processing of analog signals, and designed to operate at a “digital transfer rate” at the highest multiplex level exceeding 45 Mbit/s or a “total digital transfer rate” exceeding 90 Mbit/s;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.b.1不管制为集成到任何民用卫星系统并在其中运行而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: 5A991.b.1 does not control equipment “specially designed” to be integrated and operated in any satellite system for civil use.

text.zh: b.2. 使用“一个话音信道的带宽”、且“数据信号速率”超过每秒9,600位的调制解调器；
text.en: b.2. Modems using the “bandwidth of one voice channel” with a “data signaling rate” exceeding 9,600 bits per second;

text.zh: b.3. 每端口“数字传输速率”超过8.5 Mbit/s的“存储程序控制”数字交叉连接设备。
text.en: b.3. Being “stored program controlled” digital cross connect equipment with “digital transfer rate” exceeding 8.5 Mbit/s per port.

text.zh: b.4. 含有下列任一物项的设备：
text.en: b.4. Being equipment containing any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. “数字传输速率”超过33 Mbit/s的“网络接入控制器”及其相关公共介质；或
text.en: b.4.a. “Network access controllers” and their related common medium having a “digital transfer rate” exceeding 33 Mbit/s; or

text.zh: b.4.b. 数字输出的每通道“数据信号速率”超过64,000 bit/s的“通信通道控制器”；
text.en: b.4.b. “Communication channel controllers” with a digital output having a “data signaling rate” exceeding 64,000 bit/s per channel;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 如任何不受管制的设备含有“网络接入控制器”，则其不得具有任何类型的电信接口，但5A991.b.4中描述而未受该款管制的接口除外。
text.en: If any uncontrolled equipment contains a “network access controller”, it cannot have any type of telecommunications interface, except those described in, but not controlled by 5A991.b.4.

text.zh: b.5. 使用“激光器”且具有下列任一特性的设备：
text.en: b.5. Employing a “laser” and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.5.a. 传输波长超过1,000 nm；或
text.en: b.5.a. A transmission wavelength exceeding 1,000 nm; or

text.zh: b.5.b. 采用模拟技术且带宽超过45 MHz；
text.en: b.5.b. Employing analog techniques and having a bandwidth exceeding 45 MHz;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.b.5.b不管制商业电视系统。
text.en: 5A991.b.5.b does not control commercial TV systems.

text.zh: b.5.c. 采用相干光传输或相干光检测技术（也称光外差或零差技术）；
text.en: b.5.c. Employing coherent optical transmission or coherent optical detection techniques (also called optical heterodyne or homodyne techniques);

text.zh: b.5.d. 采用波分复用技术；或
text.en: b.5.d. Employing wavelength division multiplexing techniques; or

text.zh: b.5.e. 执行“光放大”；
text.en: b.5.e. Performing “optical amplification”;

text.zh: b.6. 输入或输出工作频率超过下列值的无线电设备：
text.en: b.6. Radio equipment operating at input or output frequencies exceeding:

text.zh: b.6.a. 卫星地面站应用为31 GHz；或
text.en: b.6.a. 31 GHz for satellite-earth station applications; or

text.zh: b.6.b. 其他应用为26.5 GHz；
text.en: b.6.b. 26.5 GHz for other applications;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.b.6不管制符合国际电信联盟（ITU）在26.5 GHz至31 GHz之间分配频段的民用设备。
text.en: 5A991.b.6. does not control equipment for civil use when conforming with an International Telecommunications Union (ITU) allocated band between 26.5 GHz and 31 GHz.

text.zh: b.7. 采用下列任一技术的无线电设备：
text.en: b.7. Being radio equipment employing any of the following:

text.zh: b.7.a. 当“总数字传输速率”超过8.5 Mbit/s时，采用高于4级的正交幅度调制（QAM）技术；
text.en: b.7.a. Quadrature-amplitude-modulation (QAM) techniques above level 4 if the “total digital transfer rate” exceeds 8.5 Mbit/s;

text.zh: b.7.b. 当“总数字传输速率”小于或等于8.5 Mbit/s时，采用高于16级的QAM技术；
text.en: b.7.b. QAM techniques above level 16 if the “total digital transfer rate” is equal to or less than 8.5 Mbit/s;

text.zh: b.7.c. 其他数字调制技术，且“频谱效率”超过3 bit/s/Hz；或
text.en: b.7.c. Other digital modulation techniques and having a “spectral efficiency” exceeding 3 bit/s/Hz; or

text.zh: b.7.d. 工作在1.5 MHz至87.5 MHz频段，并采用对干扰信号抑制超过15 dB的自适应技术。
text.en: b.7.d. Operating in the 1.5 MHz to 87.5 MHz band and incorporating adaptive techniques providing more than 15 dB suppression of an interfering signal.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 5A991.b.7不管制为集成到任何民用卫星系统并在其中运行而“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: 1. 5A991.b.7 does not control equipment “specially designed” to be integrated and operated in any satellite system for civil use.

text.zh: 2. 5A991.b.7不管制在ITU分配频段内运行的下列无线电中继设备：
text.en: 2. 5A991.b.7 does not control radio relay equipment for operation in an ITU allocated band:

text.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a. Having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 频率不超过960 MHz；或
text.en: a.1. Not exceeding 960 MHz; or

text.zh: a.2. “总数字传输速率”不超过8.5 Mbit/s；以及
text.en: a.2. With a “total digital transfer rate” not exceeding 8.5 Mbit/s; and

text.zh: b. “频谱效率”不超过4 bit/s/Hz。
text.en: b. Having a “spectral efficiency” not exceeding 4 bit/s/Hz.

text.zh: c. 具有下列任一特性、功能或特点的“存储程序控制”交换设备及相关信令系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“部件”和“附件”：
text.en: c. “Stored program controlled” switching equipment and related signaling systems, having any of the following characteristics, functions or features, and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 具有数字输入和数字输出、并提供交换功能的统计复用器，视为“存储程序控制”交换机。
text.en: Statistical multiplexers with digital input and digital output which provide switching are treated as “stored program controlled” switches.

text.zh: c.1. 为“分组模式操作”设计的“数据（报文）交换”设备或系统，以及其他未列明的相关“零件”、电子组件和“部件”。
text.en: c.1. “Data (message) switching” equipment or systems designed for “packet-mode operation” and “parts,” electronic assemblies and “components” therefor, n.e.s.
c.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.3. “数据报”分组的路由或交换；
text.en: c.3. Routing or switching of “datagram” packets;
c.4. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.c.3中的限制不适用于仅限使用“网络接入控制器”的网络，也不适用于“网络接入控制器”本身。
text.en: The restrictions in 5A991.c.3 do not apply to networks restricted to using only “network access controllers” or to “network access controllers” themselves.

text.zh: c.5. 电路交换的多级优先和抢占；
text.en: c.5. Multi-level priority and pre-emption for circuit switching;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.c.5不管制单级呼叫抢占。
text.en: 5A991.c.5 does not control single-level call preemption.

text.zh: c.6. 设计为可将蜂窝无线电呼叫自动切换至其他蜂窝交换机，或自动连接至由多个交换机共用的集中式用户数据库；
text.en: c.6. Designed for automatic hand-off of cellular radio calls to other cellular switches or automatic connection to a centralized subscriber data base common to more than one switch;

text.zh: c.7. 含有每端口“数字传输速率”超过8.5 Mbit/s的“存储程序控制”数字交叉连接设备。
text.en: c.7. Containing “stored program controlled” digital cross connect equipment with “digital transfer rate” exceeding 8.5 Mbit/s per port.

text.zh: c.8. 在非关联或准关联模式下运行的“公共信道信令”；
text.en: c.8. “Common channel signaling” operating in either non-associated or quasi-associated mode of operation;

text.zh: c.9. “动态自适应路由”；
text.en: c.9. “Dynamic adaptive routing”;

text.zh: c.10. 端口或线路超过下列任一指标的分组交换机、电路交换机和路由器：
text.en: c.10. Being packet switches, circuit switches and routers with ports or lines exceeding any of the following:

text.zh: c.10.a. “通信通道控制器”的每通道“数据信号速率”为64,000 bit/s；或
text.en: c.10.a. A “data signaling rate” of 64,000 bit/s per channel for a “communications channel controller”; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5A991.c.10.a不管制仅由各自不受5A991.b.1管制的通信通道组成的复用复合链路。
text.en: 5A991.c.10.a does not control multiplex composite links composed only of communication channels not individually controlled by 5A991.b.1.

text.zh: c.10.b. “网络接入控制器”及相关公共介质的“数字传输速率”为33 Mbit/s；
text.en: c.10.b. A “digital transfer rate” of 33 Mbit/s for a “network access controller” and related common media;

text.zh: e. 5D001.a或5D001.c所列以外、为执法监控或分析而“专门设计”或改装，且提供以下全部功能的“软件”：
text.en: e. “Software”, other than that specified by 5D001.a or 5D001.c, “specially designed” or modified for monitoring or analysis by law enforcement, providing all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 依据“硬选择标识符”，对通过“交付接口”从通信服务提供商获取的通信内容或元数据执行搜索；以及
text.en: e.1. Execution of searches on the basis of “hard selectors” of either the content of communication or metadata acquired from a communications service provider using a 'handover interface'; and

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就5D001.e而言，“交付接口”是为经授权执法机关使用而设计的物理和逻辑接口，经此接口向通信服务提供商请求定向截获措施，并由通信服务提供商向请求机关交付截获结果。“交付接口”在接收和验证截获请求的系统或设备（例如中介设备）中实现，并仅向请求机关交付符合已验证请求的截获结果。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 5D001.e, a 'handover interface' is a physical and logical interface, designed for use by an authorised law enforcement authority, across which targeted interception measures are requested from a communications service provider and the results of interception are delivered from a communications service provider to the requesting authority. The 'handover interface' is implemented within systems or equipment (e.g., mediation devices) that receive and validate the interception request, and deliver to the requesting authority only the results of interception that fulfil the validated request.

text.zh: 2. “交付接口”可由国际标准（包括但不限于ETSI TS 101 331、ETSI TS 101 671、3GPP TS 33.108）或等效国家标准规定。
text.en: 2. 'Handover interfaces' may be specified by international standards (including but not limited to ETSI TS 101 331, ETSI TS 101 671, 3GPP TS 33.108) or national equivalents.

text.zh: e.2. 根据对通信内容或元数据的搜索结果，或5D001.e.1所述搜索结果，绘制目标个人的关系网络或跟踪其移动。
text.en: e.2. Mapping of the relational network or tracking the movement of targeted individuals based on the results of searches on content of communication or metadata or searches as described in 5D001.e.1.

text.en: a. “Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development”, “production” or “use” (excluding operation) of equipment, functions or features, controlled by 5A001 or “software” controlled by 5D001.a or 5D001.e.

text.zh: b. 下列特定“技术”：
text.en: b. Specific “technology”, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. “开发”或“生产”为卫星搭载使用而“专门设计”的电信设备所“必需”的“技术”；
text.en: b.1. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of telecommunications equipment “specially designed” to be used on board satellites;

text.zh: b.2. 用于“开发”或“使用”具备自动捕获和跟踪信号、并通过大气层外或水下介质维持通信能力的“激光”通信技术的“技术”；
text.en: b.2. “Technology” for the “development” or “use” of “laser” communication techniques with the capability of automatically acquiring and tracking signals and maintaining communications through exoatmosphere or sub-surface (water) media;

text.zh: b.3. 用于“开发”数字蜂窝无线电基站接收设备的“技术”，该设备可通过更改“软件”修改接收能力，从而实现多频段、多通道、多模式、多编码算法或多协议运行；
text.en: b.3. “Technology” for the “development” of digital cellular radio base station receiving equipment whose reception capabilities that allow multi-band, multi-channel, multi-mode, multi-coding algorithm or multi-protocol operation can be modified by changes in “software”;

text.zh: b.4. 用于“开发”“扩频”技术（包括“跳频”技术）的“技术”。
text.en: b.4. “Technology” for the “development” of “spread spectrum” techniques, including “frequency hopping” techniques.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5E001.b.4不适用于“开发”下列任一物项的“技术”：
text.en: 5E001.b.4 does not apply to “technology” for the “development” of any of the following:

text.zh: a. 民用蜂窝无线电通信系统；或
text.en: a. Civil cellular radio-communications systems; or

text.zh: b. 商业民用电信的固定或移动卫星地面站。
text.en: b. Fixed or mobile satellite Earth stations for commercial civil telecommunications.

text.zh: c. 根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”或“生产”下列任一物项的“技术”：
text.en: c. “Technology” according the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:
c.1. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.2. 使用“激光器”且具有下列任一特性的设备：
text.en: c.2. Equipment employing a “laser” and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.2.a. 传输波长超过1,750 nm；
text.en: c.2.a. A transmission wavelength exceeding 1,750 nm;

text.zh: c.2.b. ［保留］
text.en: c.2.b. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.2.c. ［保留］
text.en: c.2.c. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.2.d. 采用光载波间隔小于100 GHz的波分复用技术；或
text.en: c.2.d. Employing wavelength division multiplexing techniques of optical carriers at less than 100 GHz spacing; or

text.zh: c.2.e. 采用模拟技术且带宽超过2.5 GHz；
text.en: c.2.e. Employing analog techniques and having a bandwidth exceeding 2.5 GHz;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5E001.c.2.e不管制商业电视系统的“技术”。
text.en: 5E001.c.2.e does not control “technology” for commercial TV systems.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 使用“激光器”的非电信设备的“开发”或“生产”“技术”，见第6类E产品组，例如6E00x。
text.en: For “technology” for the “development” or “production” of non-telecommunications equipment employing a “laser”, see Product Group E of Category 6, e.g., 6E00x

text.zh: c.3. 采用“光交换”且交换时间小于1 ms的设备；或
text.en: c.3. Equipment employing “optical switching” and having a switching time less than 1 ms; or

text.zh: c.4. 具有下列任一特性的无线电设备：
text.en: c.4. Radio equipment having any of the following:

text.zh: c.4.a. 采用高于1,024级的正交幅度调制（QAM）技术；或
text.en: c.4.a. Quadrature-Amplitude-Modulation (QAM) techniques above level 1,024; or

text.zh: c.4.b. 输入或输出工作频率超过31.8 GHz；或
text.en: c.4.b. Operating at input or output frequencies exceeding 31.8 GHz; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 5E001.c.4.b不管制为在“由ITU分配”给无线电通信业务而非无线电测定业务的任何频段内运行而设计或改装的设备的“技术”。
text.en: 5E001.c.4.b does not control “technology” for equipment designed or modified for operation in any frequency band which is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.

text.zh: c.4.c. 工作在1.5 MHz至87.5 MHz频段，并采用对干扰信号抑制超过15 dB的自适应技术；或
text.en: c.4.c. Operating in the 1.5 MHz to 87.5 MHz band and incorporating adaptive techniques providing more than 15 dB suppression of an interfering signal; or
c.5. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.6. 同时具有以下全部特性的移动设备：
text.en: c.6. Mobile equipment having all of the following:

text.zh: c.6.a. 工作光波长大于或等于200 nm且小于或等于400 nm；以及
text.en: c.6.a. Operating at an optical wavelength greater than or equal to 200nm and less than or equal to 400nm; and

text.zh: c.6.b. 作为“局域网”运行；
text.en: c.6.b. Operating as a “local area network”;

text.zh: d. 根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”或“生产”为电信“专门设计”、且具有下列任一特性的“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器的“技术”：
text.en: d. “Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers “specially designed” for telecommunications and that are any of the following:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就5E001.d而言，峰值饱和输出功率这一参数在产品数据表中也可能称为输出功率、饱和输出功率、最大输出功率、峰值输出功率或峰值包络输出功率。
text.en: For purposes of 5E001.d, the parameter peak saturated power output may also be referred to on product data sheets as output power, saturated power output, maximum power output, peak power output, or peak envelope power output.

text.zh: d.1. 额定工作频率超过2.7 GHz且不高于6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a. 在超过2.7 GHz且不高于2.9 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于75 W（48.75 dBm）；
text.en: d.1.a. A peak saturated power output greater than 75 W (48.75 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: d.1.b. 在超过2.9 GHz且不高于3.2 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于55 W（47.4 dBm）；
text.en: d.1.b. A peak saturated power output greater than 55 W (47.4 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: d.1.c. 在超过3.2 GHz且不高于3.7 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
text.en: d.1.c. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: d.1.d. 在超过3.7 GHz且不高于6.8 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
text.en: d.1.d. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: d.2. 额定工作频率超过6.8 GHz且不高于16 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 16 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a. 在超过6.8 GHz且不高于8.5 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 W（40 dBm）；或
text.en: d.2.a. A peak saturated power output greater than 10W (40 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

text.zh: d.2.b. 在超过8.5 GHz且不高于16 GHz的任何频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37 dBm）；
text.en: d.2.b. A peak saturated power output greater than 5W (37 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 16 GHz;

text.zh: d.3. 在超过16 GHz且不高于31.8 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于3 W（34.77 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: d.3. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 3 W (34.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: d.4. 在超过31.8 GHz且不高于37 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: d.4. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: d.5. 在超过37 GHz且不高于43.5 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: d.5. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: d.6. 在超过43.5 GHz且不高于75 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: d.6. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: d.7. 在超过75 GHz且不高于90 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于10 mW（10 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
text.en: d.7. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 10 mW (10 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

text.zh: d.8. 在超过90 GHz的任何频率下，额定峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: d.8. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: e. 根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”或“生产”为电信“专门设计”的电子器件和电路的“技术”；上述器件和电路含有用“超导”材料制造的“部件”，为在低于至少一种“超导”组成材料的“临界温度”下运行而“专门设计”，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e. “Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of electronic devices and circuits, “specially designed” for telecommunications and containing “components” manufactured from “superconductive” materials, “specially designed” for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of the “superconductive” constituents and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 使用“超导”门进行数字电路电流切换，每门延迟时间（秒）与每门功耗（瓦）的乘积小于10^{−14} J；或
text.en: e.1. Current switching for digital circuits using “superconductive” gates with a product of delay time per gate (in seconds) and power dissipation per gate (in watts) of less than 10^{−14} J; or

text.zh: e.2. 使用Q值超过10,000的谐振电路在所有频率上进行频率选择。
text.en: e.2. Frequency selection at all frequencies using resonant circuits with Q-values exceeding 10,000.
